validation_entry.TransNCS: The analyses of the Patterson function reveals a significant off-origin peak that is 81.17 % of the origin peak, indicating pseudo-translational symmetry.  The chance of finding a peak of this or larger height by random in a structure without pseudo-translational symmetry is equal to 3.7771e-07. The detected translational NCS is most likely also responsible for the elevated intensity ratio.  See the relevant section of the logfile for more details.
